commands.label: write-lean-claude-desktop-config
commands.note: Backup then write lean config with only desktop-commander, then launch Claude Desktop
commands.command: powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "$p=[System.Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables('%APPDATA%\\Claude\\claude_desktop_config.json'); $b=[System.Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables('%APPDATA%\\Claude\\claude_desktop_config_bak_1030.json'); Copy-Item $p $b -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; '{\"mcpServers\":{\"desktop-commander\":{\"command\":\"npx\",\"args\":[\"-y\",\"@wonderwhy-er/desktop-commander@latest\"]}}}' | Set-Content $p -Encoding UTF8; Start-Sleep 2; explorer 'shell:appsFolder\AnthropicPBC.Claude_p874v2pg6g7v8!Claude'"
